description:
Join to apply for the Enterprise Customer Success Manager role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include leading public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across sectors. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing, with a global team of over 1200 colleagues in 75+ countries, mostly remote, with few office-based roles.

Role Overview

The Customer Success department at Canonical is strategic, aiming to reduce risk and churn, facilitate product adoption, and support account expansion. Customer Success Managers (CSMs) develop trust with customers, understand their objectives, and align expectations to enhance loyalty and satisfaction. They also identify additional service opportunities and help craft collaboration roadmaps.

Team Structure & Responsibilities

  • Specialized in segments: Mass, Focus, Step Growth, and support for unassigned customers including Store clients.
  • Onboard new customers, introducing products like Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, and data applications.
  • Coordinate complex projects with developers, IT managers, and decision-makers across industries.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Engineering, and Support to develop engagement plans.
  • Manage customer portfolios, identify growth opportunities, and mitigate renewal risks.
  • Lead weekly customer and business reviews, prioritize blockers, and coordinate with internal teams.
  • Advocate for customers internally, influencing product roadmaps, documentation, and processes.
  • Support customers through reactive ticketing and create targeted campaigns.

Candidate Profile

Ideal candidates will have at least 5 years of IT-related experience, with familiarity in Linux OS, data applications, storage, cloud, networking, security, migration, or IoT. Strong presentation skills, process improvement experience, and team collaboration are essential. Knowledge of agile methodologies and proficiency in English, with additional languages like Spanish and Portuguese, are highly valued.

Additional Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce, Jira, and CRM tools is a plus.

What We Offer

Competitive global compensation, annual reviews, bonuses, and benefits including learning budgets, wellness programs, travel opportunities, and flexible work arrangements. The role is remote, with periodic in-person team sprints.

About Canonical

Canonical pioneers open source innovation, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud. We hire globally, uphold high standards, and foster a diverse, inclusive workplace. Working here is future-oriented, encouraging continuous learning and growth.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We value diversity and are committed to providing fair opportunities regardless of background or identity.

description:
Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

The group's key figures are approximately: Turnover of 6.5 billion euros, more than 940 laboratories in 62 countries and around 62,000 employees.

Job Description

SUMMARY OF POSITION AND OBJECTIVES:

The Release Manager role will be responsible for deploying builds across the environment, on-boarding new environment , Handling transversal projects and create release management related document and share release plan with the stakeholders

  • Manage risks and resolves issues that affect release scope, schedule and quality
  • Facilitate release activities across all releases, mainly with ensuring quality, timely deployments across environments
  • Maintains the release schedule for all core services and ensure alignment across key partners and vendors.
  • Coordinate release content and effort based on the service request backlog, pending service requests, third party applications, or operating system updates
  • Communicate all key project plans, commitments, and changes including QA plans, schedule, and scope changes.
  • Conduct Release Readiness reviews, Milestone Reviews, and Business Go/No-Go reviews with stakeholders
  • Produce Deployment, Run Books and Implementation Plans
  • Participate in CAB meetings to present Production changes (RFCs)
  • Lead and co-ordinate the Go-Live activities including the execution of the deployment Plans and checklists.
  • Weekly Release Reporting with Program release manager.
  • Own and continually improve the release process by documenting release issues and developing plans to improve processes, able to recommend continuous improvements viz: automation .
  • Comfortable in interacting with people across hierarchical levels for smooth project execution. Enjoys managing complex projects involving challenges.
Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

  • English Language is mandatory to collaborate in a global environment, including writing, speaking and presenting.
  • Understanding of Continuous Delivery and Continuous Integration (CD/CI) pipelines
  • Good understanding of cloud deployment, preferably Azure and Agile practice
  • Knowledge on Deployment tool like Octopus
  • Knowledge on MS Project, Excel-Macros
  • Document Management for adhere to Audit Compliance process is an added advantage
  • 4 to 5 years of relevant release and deployment management experience
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional work teams towards task completion
  • Demonstrated effective leadership and analytical skills
  • Strong in troubleshooting and organizational skills and ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.
    Desired Technical Stack:
  • Platforms : Windows, Linux.
  • Database : MSSQL
  • Ticketing Tools: Service now
  • Cloud Environment : MS Azure
  • CI and Build Deployment Tools : Octopus Deploy
  • Version Control Tool : Azure Devops
  • Monitoring tools : Grafana

title: Trainmaster (CVRR)
description:
Supervises and coordinates activities of train crew engaged in switching railroad cars within yard of railroad, industrial plant, or similar location to facilitate loading or unloading of cars or making up and breaking up of trains; and/or switches railroad cars within yard of railroad, industrial plant, or similar location to load and unload cars or to make up or break up trains in a safe and efficient manner, by performing the following duties.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities :

  • Supervises and coordinates the activities of train crews.
  • Receives oral or written instructions from Manager or Customer indicating which cars are to be switched.
  • Notifies train crew of switching orders and, whereby, which cars are to be moved to specified locations of yard, using radio, telephone, verbal, or hand signals.
  • Manage cars online through various RMI reports.
  • Must ensure daily train lists are accurate as generated by the customer service department, and accurate as completed by the train crews within his/her territory.
  • Must ensure all reporting is done accurately and timely, including daily crew work sheets and weekly operational reporting.
  • Approve all man hours under his/her area of responsibility and forward these hours to the necessary personnel or department on a timely basis.
  • Initiate and provide an accurate, complete, and timely investigation of all accidents and incidents, including causes, remedial action, and recommended solutions.
  • Understand the quantitative factors contributing to the major costs on the railroad and understand the extent of their effect toward financial performances.
  • Adjust locomotive consist requirements based on HP and trailing tons daily, with a goal to minimize locomotive fuel and maximize locomotive utilization.
  • Understand all outstanding track conditions within his/her territory, including slow orders, and their effect on productivity/efficiency.
  • Demonstrate predictable, reliable, and timely attendance.
  • Knowledge of and skills in applying basic federal railroad regulations, guidelines, and rules.
  • Ability to read and comprehend written safety rules, procedure and safety manuals, government regulations, operating and maintenance instructions, memos, and other work-related information.
  • Ability to apply commonsense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, diagrammatic, or schedule form; and/or to apply principles of logic to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions; and/or to apply principles of rational systems to solve practical problems.
  • Ability to effectively communicate instructions, directions, processes, procedures, safety rules and regulations to co-workers, supervisors, and others in written, oral, diagrammatic and schedule form.
  • Ability to train switch crews and other yard personnel to perform job-related duties; and to provide training related to federal and company regulations, rules, safety guidelines and preventive maintenance.
  • Ability to make independent judgments using sound reasoning skills and knowledge base.
  • Ability to think and act quickly in responding to emergency and non-emergency situations.
  • Ability to talk to and effectively communicate with co-workers, yard personnel, switching crew, engineers, railroad officials and others in a clear, concise, courteous, efficient, and professional manner.
  • Promote and facilitate company safety initiatives and instill a culture of safety
  • Manages the operational testing program by observing, documenting, and evaluating safe work practices and rules compliance
  • Ability to pass training and required testing.
  • Performs other duties as requested or required

Machines, Tools, Special Equipment, Personal Protective Equipment Used:

  • PPE; hard hat, vest, safety glasses, FR clothing, gloves, steel toed boots

Education and Experience:

  • High school education or general education development (GED), and minimum of 6 months job-related experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Ability to pass training and required testing.

Certificates and Licenses:

  • Must hold, and continue to hold, a current locomotive engineers and conductor’s certification.

Work Environment: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The team member is regularly exposed to outside weather conditions and elements, noise, and fumes from gas, oil, and grease.

Note: The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by team members assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified.

description:

A Agência do Trabalhador de Jussara abriu inscrições para 15 cursos profissionalizantes gratuitos destinados a moradores da cidade e região. Os cursos, realizados em parceria com o Serviço Nacional de Aprendizagem Rural (SENAR), oferecem uma ampla variedade de temas que vão desde capacitações técnicas até desenvolvimento pessoal. A previsão é que as aulas comecem assim que todas as vagas forem preenchidas.

Entre as opções oferecidas estão cursos voltados para a área tecnológica, como operação de drones e prevenção e combate a incêndios, e para o setor agrícola, com capacitações em cultivo de mamão, melancia e banana, além de pulverização agrícola. Também há vagas para treinamentos em boas práticas na cozinha, oratória e qualidade de vida de idosos, bem como para atividades de artesanato, incluindo a produção de flores, bonecos e artesanato apícola. Na área de máquinas pesadas, são oferecidos cursos de operação de pá carregadeira e retroescavadeira. Outro destaque é o curso “Mulher Atual”, voltado para o empoderamento feminino e habilidades de gestão.

As inscrições podem ser feitas gratuitamente por telefone, pelos números (44) 99965-5165 e (44) 3628-2553, ou presencialmente na Agência do Trabalhador de Jussara durante o horário comercial. As vagas são limitadas e preenchidas por ordem de inscrição, o que exige agilidade dos interessados.

Os cursos serão ministrados na própria cidade, com estrutura e suporte do SENAR, que visa capacitar a população para atender às demandas do mercado de trabalho e promover o desenvolvimento econômico local. A iniciativa busca qualificar os participantes e gerar mais oportunidades de emprego e renda para a comunidade.

title: Arquiteto de Dados - Curitiba/PR ou São Paulo/SP
description:
Arquiteto de Dados - Curitiba/PR ou São Paulo/SP

Join to apply for the Arquiteto de Dados - Curitiba/PR ou São Paulo/SP role at MadeiraMadeira

Na MadeiraMadeira, temos uma missão clara: incentivar uma cultura orientada a dados, otimizando a descentralização e autonomia de análises, suportando melhores decisões que permitam prover a melhor experiência aos nossos clientes.

A área de dados oferece uma série de oportunidades desafiadoras e emocionantes, especialmente no que diz respeito à arquitetura de dados. Como parte de uma equipe dedicada, você estará envolvido em projetos que visam estruturar, integrar e governar dados de maneira eficiente e inovadora, com o objetivo de impactar diretamente o sucesso da empresa.

A crescente demanda por dados e informações exige arquiteturas escaláveis e flexíveis, e sua missão será criar soluções que garantam a capacidade de lidar com grandes volumes de dados de forma ágil e eficaz. Trabalhar com fontes de dados diversificadas, como sistemas internos, bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, além de APIs e outras plataformas, será uma oportunidade de aplicar e expandir suas habilidades na integração de dados.

A otimização da performance também será uma das suas missões. Ao integrar ferramentas analíticas avançadas, como business intelligence e machine learning, você contribuirá para o design de fluxos de dados que suportem análises em tempo real ou em batches de forma eficiente, sem sobrecarregar o sistema. Aqui, você terá a chance de aplicar suas habilidades em engenharia de dados para criar soluções robustas e de alta performance.

A evolução constante das necessidades do negócio será um estímulo para sua criatividade e inovação. Sua capacidade de adaptar e atualizar a arquitetura de dados para atender às novas demandas, tecnologias e fontes de dados será essencial, garantindo que a empresa esteja sempre à frente das tendências e preparada para o futuro.

Em resumo, a missão na área de dados será desafiadora, mas cheia de oportunidades de crescimento e impacto. Você terá a chance de moldar a arquitetura de dados de forma estratégica, promovendo eficiência, inovação e segurança, e tornando-se uma peça chave para o sucesso da organização. Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, em constante evolução e com um grande potencial de impacto, essa é a oportunidade ideal para alavancar sua carreira na área de dados.

Na MadeiraMadeira acreditamos que a base para uma operação eficiente, escalável e orientada a dados é uma arquitetura sólida e moderna. O Arquiteto de Dados será responsável por desenhar, implementar e evoluir uma arquitetura de dados que suporte os desafios de um varejo digital dinâmico e em constante crescimento.

Seu papel será garantir que os dados estejam disponíveis, confiáveis e acessíveis para as áreas de negócio, produto e operações. Você liderará a transformação da infraestrutura de dados, promovendo governança robusta, integração ágil de dados e escalabilidade. O objetivo final é habilitar decisões mais rápidas e assertivas, reduzir perdas operacionais e impulsionar métricas críticas, como aumento do GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) e redução de custos logísticos.

O Que Estamos Procurando

Buscamos um profissional apaixonado por resolver problemas complexos de dados, com experiência em ambientes de alta escala e em iniciativas que conectem tecnologia e estratégia de negócios.

Venha transformar o futuro do e-commerce de casa com a gente.

  • Principais Responsabilidades
    • Planejamento e Implementação da Arquitetura de Dados :
      • Liderar a adoção da arquitetura de dados baseada no modelo Medalhão, habilitando domínios de dados conforme os princípios do Data Mesh.
      • Definir padrões e frameworks para a ingestão, processamento, armazenamento e consumo de dados, garantindo escalabilidade e eficiência.
    • Governança e Qualidade de Dados :
      • Implementar políticas e ferramentas de governança para garantir consistência, segurança e qualidade dos dados.
      • Estabelecer um modelo de single source of truth, minimizando redundâncias e inconsistências.
    • Colaboração Estratégica :
      • Trabalhar em parceria com times de engenharia, ciência de dados, produto e negócio para traduzir necessidades em soluções arquiteturais.
      • Garantir que a arquitetura de dados apoie iniciativas estratégicas, como personalização, otimização logística e redução de custos operacionais.
    • Inovação e Otimização Contínua :
      • Monitorar tendências e inovações em arquitetura de dados, avaliando tecnologias como data lakes, data warehouses e ferramentas de observabilidade.
      • Otimizar pipelines e fluxos de dados para melhorar desempenho e custo-benefício.
    • Mentoria e Liderança Técnica :
      • Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico do time, promovendo boas práticas e cultura de dados.
      • Servir como referência técnica em projetos críticos relacionados à arquitetura de dados.
Principais Ferramentas, Tecnologias e Padrões

O Arquiteto de Dados deve dominar uma ampla gama de ferramentas e tecnologias modernas para projetar e implementar soluções robustas, escaláveis e alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio. Isso inclui ferramentas de processamento e orquestração de dados para garantir fluxos de dados automatizados e resilientes. Tecnologias de armazenamento e análise são essenciais para a construção de data lakes e warehouses performáticos. Além disso, o uso de frameworks distribuídos é indispensável para o processamento de grandes volumes de dados em tempo real ou batch.

Em relação aos padrões de mercado, o arquiteto deve ter profundo conhecimento de arquiteturas como Data Lakehouse , Data Mesh , e Lambda/Kappa Architectures , que atendem às necessidades de escalabilidade, descentralização e processamento em tempo real. Domínio em governança e qualidade de dados e confiabilidade dos dados. Além disso, é esperado conhecimento em linguagens de programação bem como proficiência em SQL para modelagem e consulta de dados. Por fim, o entendimento de frameworks de segurança e compliance, como ISO 27001 , LGPD , e GDPR , é fundamental para mitigar riscos e garantir a conformidade regulatória.

Indicadores de Sucesso
  • Redução de inconsistências em dados críticos para abaixo de 5%.
  • Aumento da disponibilidade da plataforma de dados para 99,9%.
  • Implementação de domínios de dados com uso efetivo em múltiplas áreas de negócio.
  • Redução de custos operacionais relacionados à gestão e integração de dados em 20%.
  • Habilitação de insights que impulsionem GMV e melhorem KPIs de eficiência logística.
Requisitos e Qualificações
  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de dados de grande porte.
  • Conhecimento de frameworks e metodologias de maturidade de dados, como o Dell Maturity Model.
  • Inglês avançado para interação com stakeholders globais e documentação técnica.
Diferenciais
  • Certificações relevantes em cloud e dados (AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake).
  • Experiência em varejo digital ou e-commerce de grande escala.
  • Contribuições em comunidades ou projetos open-source relacionados a arquitetura de dados.

description:

Hogarth is the Global Content Experience Company. Part of WPP, Hogarth partners with one in every two of the world’s top 100 brands including Coca-Cola, Ford, Rolex, Nestlé, Mondelez and Dyson. With a breadth of experience across an extensive range of sectors, Hogarth offers the unrivaled ability to deliver relevant, engaging, and measurable content across all channels and media - both established and emerging. The number of channels at our fingertips; the need for speed; and the drive for mass personalisation, all mean that brands need different solutions. Our global team of over 7,500 craft and technology experts brings together creative, production and innovation to help clients navigate this exciting and ever-changing world of today’s content experience.
WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. Working at WPP means being part of a global network of more than 100,000 talented people dedicated to doing extraordinary work for our clients. We operate in over 100 countries, with corporate headquarters in New York, London and Singapore. WPP is a world leader in marketing services, with deep AI, data and technology capabilities, global presence and unrivalled creative talent. Our clients include many of the biggest companies and advertisers in the world, including approximately 300 of the Fortune Global 500. Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.
The Role
Project Managers own the end-to-end project management of projects. They are responsible for delivering a completed project on time, on specification, and on budget. Project Managers must demonstrate a good understanding of project management tools and best-practice methodology, and the flexibility to lead a diverse and dynamic team to deliver balanced integrated solutions. The project manager is everyone's point person for the project. Team members rely on them for everything they need to know about a project: what to expect, what to do next, and to find out where they need to be. Project Managers relay information about timing, scope, budgets, resources and changes to the project plan.
Key Areas Of Responsibilities
Communication

  • The key day-to-day project contact with lower to mid-level clients
  • Possesses accurate sense of client satisfaction level - facilitates the sharing of client feedback with the team and management; sensitive to the client's needs and concerns.
  • Takes accountability to ensure that all team members are aware of timelines and deliverables
Collaboration
  • Partners with the client services, project management, production and finance leads across channels to ensure a smooth process, proper resource allocation, and a superior end result
  • Ensures team members feel personal accountability for deliverables and projects, engaging in all aspects of team assignments driving towards progress, actions and results
  • Develops and maintains high levels of team effectiveness (trust, communication, collaboration, productivity diversity and engagement)
Process
  • Manage small to medium sized projects independently, from initiation through completion
  • Serve as the production expert on integrated marketing campaigns, working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced agency environment
  • Possesses an in-depth understanding of project management techniques and brings process innovation in how we manage our engagements
  • Manages client objectives, budgets, expectations, deliverables and timelines and communicating changes/directions to team members
  • Keeps projects on track through clear task lists, issue tracking, status reports, and meeting notes
  • Participates actively and can knowledgably articulate status internally or during client interactions
  • Influences the efficiency and quality of work and advocating for the agency/client relationship
Financial Management
  • Works with interdisciplinary teams of creative, production and technologists to define and develop scopes and estimates of projects (goals, deliverables, schedule, and budget), helping to translate creative concepts into clear sets of deliverables with proper staffing
  • Owns project budget and tracking of all ongoing costs throughout project lifecycle, reconcile estimates to actuals on all projects, and resolution of budget discrepancies between disciplines, vendors and clients
Risk Management
  • Focuses on delivering great print work and proactively identifies barriers to creating great work and works to remove them, when applicable, raises larger issues to senior management
Hogarth
  • Demonstrates understanding of Hogarth’s capabilities and production process.
Day to day tasks can include
  • Develops and maintaining scopes, timelines and budgets
  • Coordinates and partners with Hogarth’s global production network to ensure global campaign launches are successful and work is completed
  • Manages status documents, agendas, contact reports, trackers and day to day communication with teams and client
  • Liaises with clients/agencies/suppliers to obtain schedules, briefs, assets, technical specifications
  • Responsible for partnering with the Business Affairs team to manage and plan talent, licensing and vendor costs
  • Manages of POs, financial reporting, tracking, billing against all project budgets
Requirements
  • 3-5 years of project management with print production experience in integrated agency or similar environment
  • Solid understanding of print production and the creative development process, knowledge digital retouch, delivery of artworks for PRINT and POS / OOH.
  • A professional and approachable demeanor, and the ability to thrive in the dynamic highly matrixed agency environment
  • Ability to manage big volume of print assets´s delivery demonstrating skills to deliver on time and on budget
  • Can show experience in bottom-up scoping of projects, creating project budgets, tracking actuals, and creating statements of work
  • Demonstrates an ability to solve problems with the solution that works for all stakeholders without compromising the quality of the deliverables or the project
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, wireframing/workflow tools, online project management/collaboration/ticketing tools e.g. JIRA, Service Anywhere, Sharepoint, Smartsheet etc.

LVHN has been ranked among the "Best Hospitals" by U.S. News & World Report for 23 consecutive years. We're a Magnet(tm) Hospital, having been honored five times with the American Nurses Credentialing Center's prestigious distinction for nursing excellence and quality patient outcomes in our Lehigh Valley region. Finally, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Cedar Crest, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Muhlenberg, Lehigh Valley Hospital- Hazleton, and Lehigh Valley Hospital - Pocono each received an 'A' grade on the Hospital Safety Grade from The Leapfrog Group in 2020, the highest grade in patient safety. Qualified candidatesare eligible for up to a $30,000 Sign on Bonus!


Summary
Administers all forms of respiratory care, both critical and general therapy, and directs and manages the respiratory and pulmonary care for a designated group of patients. Provides respiratory assessment, support, treatment, and diagnostic tests as part of the healthcare team.
Job Duties

  • Conducts evaluation, management and care of patients with deficiencies and abnormalities of the cardiopulmonary system
  • Performs mechanical ventilator management, Bi-pap, and respiratory monitoring.
  • Sets up, checks equipment, and administers respiratory medication for aerosol treatment as ordered by the physicians/or by patient-driven protocols, charts treatment, response, and progress.
  • Performs inventory of respiratory equipment and maintains adequate stock of equipment.
  • Provides respiratory therapy to patients as ordered by physicians according to established standards and practices.
  • Trains other staff including physicians and students in issues relevant to respiratory therapy.
  • Performs emergency cardiopulmonary resuscitation and maintains adequate airways, measures ventilator volumes, pressures, and flows of patients requiring critical care.
  • Performs arterial blood gas studies as well as pulse oximetry, interpretation, and analysis.
  • Educates patients in collaboration in various clinical situations such as sleep apnea and CPAP machines, proper fitting of mask and headgear, and setting of pressures in concordance to sleep studio requirements.
  • Sets-up diagnostic nocturnal sleep screens.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Associate’s Degree Graduate from an RRT program accredited by the commission of accreditation for Respiratory Care
  • Less than 1 year
  • Ability to provide respiratory therapy methodologies and techniques.
  • Ability to operate and trouble-shoot diagnostic equipment.
  • RRT - Registered Respiratory Therapist NBRC - State of Pennsylvania within 1 Year
  • ACLS - Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 30 Days
  • PALS - Pediatric Advanced Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days
  • NRP - Neonatal Resuscitation Program - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days
  • RCP - Respiratory Care Practitioner - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire


Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree Graduate from an RRT program accredited by the commission of accreditation for Respiratory Care
  • 1 year Experience as a registered respiratory therapist.


Physical Demands
Lift and carry 40-50 lbs. Examples: Push/pull patients on bed, stretcher (requires 29 lbs. push force), lateral transfers up to 50 lbs. of the patient's weight. Frequent to continuous standing/walking. Patient transporters can walk 8-10 miles per shift. *Patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Análise de Notas Fiscais de Saída: Realizar uma análise abrangente das notas fiscais de vendas para garantir a precisão e conformidade com as normas fiscais.
  2. Análise de Notas Fiscais de Devoluções: Examinar minuciosamente as notas fiscais decorrentes de devoluções, identificando e resolvendo possíveis discrepâncias.
  3. Lançamento e Validação de Documentos Fiscais: Gerenciar o lançamento e validação dos documentos fiscais, assegurando a exatidão e integridade das transações financeiras.
  4. Lançamento de Conhecimentos de Transporte Eletrônicos (CTEs): Registrar e validar os CTEs de acordo com os requisitos legais e procedimentos internos.
  5. Análise e Controle de Clientes Simples Nacional: Realizar análises detalhadas e fornecer suporte especializado para clientes enquadrados no regime do Simples Nacional.
  6. Parametrização de Clientes no Sistema: Configurar e ajustar os parâmetros fiscais e contábeis no sistema de acordo com as necessidades específicas de cada cliente.
  7. Envio de Carta TTD via E-mail (Estorno de Crédito de ICMS): Gerenciar o processo de envio de cartas de estorno de crédito de ICMS, garantindo a conformidade com os regulamentos fiscais e procedimentos internos.
  8. Conferência e Ajuste de Estoque: Realizar verificações regulares e ajustes no estoque, reconciliando as informações das notas fiscais com o sistema de gestão.
  9. Conferência entre SAT e Sistema: Conduzir verificações periódicas para garantir a consistência entre os registros do Sistema de Autenticação e Transmissão (SAT) e o sistema contábil.
  10. Análise e Configuração de CFOP: Analisar e configurar corretamente os códigos fiscais de operações e prestações (CFOP) para garantir a precisão no registro das transações.
  11. Apuração de Impostos (ICMS, IPI, Pis, Cofins, IR e Contribuição Social): Realizar cálculos precisos e oportunos para apurar os impostos de ICMS, IPI, Pis, Cofins, IR e CSLL utilizando modelos e relatórios do sistema.
  12. Suporte à Emissão de Nota Fiscal Eletrônica (Exportação): Prestar suporte especializado na emissão de notas fiscais eletrônicas para operações de exportação, garantindo conformidade com as regulamentações fiscais internacionais.
  13. Levantamento de Notas de Avarias e Geração de Guias: Coletar e fornecer à contabilidade um levantamento detalhado das notas de avarias no último dia do mês, facilitando a geração precisa das guias correspondentes.
  14. Comunicação com Clientes: Estabelecer uma comunicação proativa com os clientes para compreender suas dúvidas e necessidades. Oferecer consultoria especializada e soluções personalizadas para resolver questões fiscais e contábeis específicas.
  15. Análise do impacto da atualização da legislação tributária.
  16. Elaboração, análise e envio de relatórios gerenciais: Apuração de impostos.

Requisitos:

  1. Curso superior em Ciências Contábeis (IMPRESCINDÍVEL)
  2. Atuação anterior na área fiscal e tributária
  3. Conhecimento em legislações fiscais e tributárias
  4. Habilidade com sistemas ERP e ferramentas de gestão
  5. Boa comunicação e habilidades analíticas
  6. Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e de maneira autônoma

O Associate Product Manager (APM) é responsável por apoiar o Product Manager na execução da estratégia do produto, focando nas atividades operacionais do dia a dia. Ele atua como um facilitador, garantindo que as necessidades dos usuários sejam atendidas e que o produto seja desenvolvido de acordo com as especificações.

Gerenciamento do Backlog:

Testes e Validação:

  1. Realizar testes de usabilidade e funcionalidade do produto;
  2. Coletar feedback dos usuários e stakeholders para validar as funcionalidades do produto;
  3. Apoiar o Product Manager na tomada de decisões sobre o produto;
  4. Garantir a estabilidade do produto, com acompanhamento diário às ferramentas de monitoramento, HotJar, Grafana, PowerBI.

Requisitos:

  3. Habilidades de comunicação e colaboração;
  4. Capacidade de organização e gerenciamento de tempo;
  5. Interesse em aprender e crescer na área de produtos digitais.

title: Sr. Sales Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Sr. Sales Engineer role at Tenstorrent

Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists has developed a high-performance RISC-V CPU from scratch and shares a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

As a Sr. Sales Engineer , you will collaborate closely with the sales team and customers, leveraging your deep technical knowledge in AI to drive the adoption of our products and solutions. You will be responsible for articulating the technical value of our offerings, conducting product demos, and addressing customer technical requirements. This is a customer-facing role that requires both technical expertise and excellent communication skills to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

This role is hybrid, based out of Santa Clara, CA; Austin, TX; Boston, MA; or Toronto, ON.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Responsibilities

  1. Pre-sales Support: Partner with the sales team to understand customer needs, tailor solutions, and deliver technical presentations that clearly explain the capabilities and benefits of our AI solutions.
  2. Customer Engagement: Engage directly with customers in meetings, presentations, and workshops to understand their technical challenges and provide effective solutions.
  3. Technical Consultation: Provide technical guidance and support during the sales cycle, ensuring that proposed solutions meet customer requirements and align with their business objectives.
  4. Solution Design: Assist customers in defining and designing AI-driven solutions that integrate seamlessly with their existing systems and workflows.
  5. Documentation & Reporting: Prepare technical documentation, including solution architectures, technical proposals, and requirements gathering reports.
  6. Collaboration: Work closely with the customer success engineering, sales operations, and product teams to provide feedback from customers and help shape future product enhancements.

Experience & Qualifications

  1. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
  2. Strong customer-facing skills with 10+ years of relevant technical, customer-facing experience (such as Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Technical Account Manager).
  3. Strong proficiency in programming languages, particularly Python.
  4. Proven expertise in AI technologies, including machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), and/or computer vision.
  5. Understanding of AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow, with expertise in Generative AI and LLM applications preferred.
  6. Experience selling AI and/or general purpose compute Hardware or Silicon IP.
  7. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear and concise manner.
  8. Passion for innovation and a proactive attitude towards learning and adopting new technologies.

Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets. Experience, skills, education, background, and location all impact the actual offer made.

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.

Our engineering positions and certain engineering support positions require access to information, systems, or technologies that are subject to U.S. Export Control laws and regulations. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. What we offer

Colaborarás con un equipo regional de ventas y marketing, y tu objetivo principal será encontrar proyectos de clientes que se ajusten a nuestras líneas de productos y promover la reputación de Canonical en diversas industrias y regiones.

  • Manejar consultas entrantes de clientes vía email, teléfono y chat.

  • Colaborar con múltiples equipos y stakeholders de alto nivel para impulsar resultados.
  • Trabajar con marketing en campañas específicas.
  • Investigar información sobre clientes potenciales.
  • Generar un pipeline de varios millones.
  • Identificar tendencias y perspectivas del mercado.
  • Contribuir a definir procesos y políticas del equipo.
  • Servir de enlace con clientes nuevos y existentes, organizando reuniones y mapeando cuentas para nuevas oportunidades.
  • Crear, actualizar y mantener clientes potenciales en oportunidades globales.

  • Excelentes resultados académicos en la escuela y universidad.
  • Pasión por negocios y tecnología.
  • Compromiso con aprendizaje y mejora continua: curioso, flexible, analítico.
  • Resolución creativa de problemas y trabajo en equipo.
  • Habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita.
  • Orientación a resultados con espíritu de superación.
  • Persistencia y perseverancia.

Qué te ofrecemos

El salario base dependerá de factores como ubicación, experiencia, conocimientos y habilidades. Además, algunos roles incluyen beneficios adicionales, bonificaciones anuales e incentivos basados en ventas o utilización. Nuestra política de compensación busca garantizar equidad a nivel global.

Ofrecemos beneficios que reflejan nuestros valores, incluyendo:

  • Revisión salarial anual.

  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Estamos construindo um banco de talentos para nossa área de Estratégia e Performance (Business Analytics). Se você tem paixão por dados e deseja atuar em projetos estratégicos que impactam diretamente o crescimento da XP Inc., queremos te conhecer! Essa oportunidade é ideal para profissionais de diferentes níveis de senioridade que buscam desafios na análise de dados para suportar a tomada de decisão e impulsionar a transformação do mercado financeiro.

Formação: Engenharias, Estatística, Administração, Economia, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência: Análise de dados, modelagem estatística e construção de dashboards.
Habilidades: Domínio de SQL e ferramentas de visualização de dados (ex: Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
Capacidade analítica: Visão estratégica para suportar decisões de negócios com insights baseados em dados.
Comunicação: Boa comunicação e habilidade para interação com diferentes áreas.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em Python ou R para manipulação e análise de dados.
  • Vivência no setor financeiro.
  • Experiência com Big Data e ferramentas na nuvem (AWS, GCP, Azure).

Desafios e Impacto

  • Desenvolver análises estratégicas e dashboards para apoiar decisões de negócios.
  • Trabalhar com times multidisciplinares para impulsionar projetos de crescimento e eficiência operacional.
  • Estruturar e otimizar processos de coleta e análise de dados, garantindo insights mais precisos e ágeis.
  • Apoiar a criação de modelos preditivos e métricas que contribuam para a estratégia da XP Inc.

Processo Seletivo

Triagem inicial: Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais: Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento: Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Avaliação técnica: Teste focado nas habilidades específicas necessárias para a função.

Entrevista com a liderança: Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

Entrevista com colegas de trabalho: Interação com futuros pares para avaliar a sinergia e o trabalho em equipe.

Entrevista focada em cultura: Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta: Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade:

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

We are hiring a Software Engineer to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu Pro client.
Ubuntu Pro is a suite of specialist services provided by Canonical. Whether for enterprise customers deploying systems at scale or users who want security patching for their personal Ubuntu LTS at home, the Ubuntu Pro Client is the command-line tool that manages all these services.
The quality and stability of the Ubuntu Pro Client is critically important, since it comes pre-installed on every Ubuntu system. You'll work with the Ubuntu Server team, alongside major cloud partners and multiple Canonical product teams to develop, test and release improvements to the Pro client. You will also be a voice in communication with our users, ensuring their needs are met.

Excellent Python skills are a key requirement, with previous contributions to open source Python projects being an advantage. The Pro client often interacts with the Ubuntu package management; therefore, experience in configuring apt, and knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous in this role.
Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions of people around the world. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. The Pro client is used at all ranges, from mission-critical environments to hobbyist Ubuntu users; applicants should be ready to work with the whole spectrum of end users and help guide engineering best practices with all of them in mind.

title: Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer
description:
Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include leading public cloud and silicon providers, along with industry leaders across sectors. With a founder-led, profitable, and growing company, we employ over 1200 colleagues across 75+ countries, with few office-based roles. Teams meet 2-4 times a year globally to align on strategy and execution.

We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer for our Information Systems (IS) team. This role offers an opportunity for an automation-focused senior technologist passionate about Linux to build a career with Canonical and support those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. Experience in IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code, and a passion for technology are essential.

Job Summary

The IS team maintains all of Canonical's IT production services, supporting over 60 million Ubuntu users. As a Senior SRE & Gitops engineer, you will drive operations automation in private and public clouds using open source infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical's automation products. You will also provide feedback to developers on product operation at scale, contribute to bug fixes and pull requests, and collaborate across teams. You will join a global team of SREs committed to delivering excellent services to our company, customers, and the Ubuntu Community.

Responsibilities

  • Lead automation development and Gitops practices as an embedded tech lead
  • Collaborate with IS architects to align solutions with architecture vision
  • Design services as products for internal use
  • Advance infrastructure as code practices, increasing automation and process improvements
  • Automate software operations for reusability and consistency across clouds
  • Maintain responsibility for core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance skills, using observability tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch
  • Support and collaborate with globally distributed teams
  • Focus on larger projects and automation during dedicated development time
  • Share expertise through design sessions, mentorship, and teamwork
  • Handle time-critical escalations responsibly

Qualifications

  • Experience with infrastructure as code across private and public clouds
  • Product mindset focused on developing products, not just solutions
  • Proficiency in Python with large projects
  • Experience with Kubernetes or similar container orchestration systems
  • Managing and deploying cloud infrastructure via code
  • Knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
  • Familiarity with Linux storage solutions like Ceph and databases
  • Hands-on Linux server administration experience
  • Understanding of cloud computing concepts and technologies
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or related field
  • Effective communication skills in English (email, chat, video, in-person)
  • Strong troubleshooting skills from kernel to web
  • Quick learner with flexibility and adaptability
  • Interest in fast-changing environments and open source, especially Ubuntu or Debian

What We Offer

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints
  • USD 2,000 annual learning and development budget
  • Annual compensation review and performance rewards
  • Comprehensive benefits including leave, parental leave, wellness programs, and travel opportunities

About Canonical

Canonical pioneers open source innovation. As the publisher of Ubuntu, we impact AI, IoT, and cloud platforms globally. We value excellence, diversity, and a discrimination-free workplace. Working remotely since 2004, we foster a forward-thinking, inclusive environment.

Additional Details

  • Senior level: Mid-Senior
  • Employment: Full-time
  • Function: Engineering & IT
  • Industry: Software Development

title: HR Business Partner, People Experience and Technology (PXT) - HR
description:
HR Business Partner, People Experience and Technology (PXT) - HR

At Amazon, we are committed to being the safest place to work in the world, the best employer, and the most customer-centric company. To get there, we need exceptionally talented and empathetic people who are passionate about making each day better for all employees — and you will play a crucial role in this journey! Our People eXperience & Technology (PXT - Human Resources) professionals care deeply about the employee experience and support employees and leaders in focusing on people through engagement, technology, and innovation.

Key job responsibilities
In this position, you will be responsible for the entire PXT (People eXperience and Technology - Human Resources) agenda in an Amazon logistics warehouse located in São João de Meriti - RJ. The generalist role in HR will involve managing the mobilization/demobilization of workforce in different hiring formats, internal communication and employee engagement, leadership development at supervisor to manager levels, general coordination of labor and employee relations issues, consolidation and reporting of metrics (absenteeism, attrition, operational vacancy fill rates), indirect coordination of chartered transportation and restaurant, continuous improvement plans for employee experience, Diversity and Inclusion programs, among others.

A day in the life
As an HRBP of a "Fulfillment Center - FC", no two days are alike, but a typical day will likely include the following responsibilities:

  1. Work with a team of HR Assistants to create the best experience for employees.
  2. Lead the reporting and analysis of Human Resources metrics and goals ("attendance", "attrition", "fill-rate", delving into root cause analyses and improvement plans).
  3. Participate in "Daily Dive Deep – DDD" meetings along with the Operations team and other support areas.
  4. Co-lead workforce planning meetings, execution of mobilization and demobilization of personnel contingent.
  5. Conduct "Gemba" and monitor operational processes, as well as the work environment and people's needs, on the "shop-floor".
  6. Monitor the environment from a labor and employee relations perspective, identifying trends and risks.

XP Future 2025 | Transição de Carreira - Espírito Santo

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP FUTURE , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Estaremos presencialmente no Espírito Santo para nosso processo seletivo e expandir ainda mais nosso time!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar em nosso Programa de Formação XP Future:

  • Graduação superior completa;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Conhecimento básico sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros).
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI)

Diferenciais, mas não eliminatórios:

  • Certificação CPA-20.

Principais desafios da cadeira:

  • Prospecção de novos negócios - poder de originação/novos clientes;
  • Organização para trabalhar diversas frentes em curto período de tempo;
  • Forte poder de persuasão;
  • Empatia e visão de longo prazo;
  • Gestão de carteiras e grandes contas - Pessoa Física e Pessoa Jurídica.

Obs: Contratação CLT

Sobre as etapas do processo seletivo - XP Future 2025 - Espírito Santo

  • Realização da etapa de testes - Fit cultural e PI (Obrigatórios)
  • Bate papo com o time de Expansão;
  • Processo seletivo presencial na cidade;
  • As pessoas candidatas aprovadas em processo seletivo serão admitidas no regime CLT e vão atuar na área do B2C;
  • Após início na XP Inc., os assessores contarão com capacitação teórica, cursos preparatórios e treinamentos para as certificações - CPA-20.

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP Vitória ! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura:

“Se te oferecem um lugar em um foguete, não pergunte qual é o assento, apenas embarque.”

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

title: Engineer II (CFD)
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced CFD Engineer to join our innovative engineering team at ABS Consulting. This role is critical in advancing our computational fluid dynamics (CFD) capabilities, driving the development of cutting-edge simulations to optimize product performance and efficiency across various applications.

What You Will Do

  1. Lead the development and implementation of CFD methodologies to analyze complex fluid flow, heat transfer, and chemical reactions.
  2. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project scopes, objectives, and deliverables, ensuring alignment with overall engineering goals.
  3. Design and execute simulation plans, including grid generation, model setup, and validation against experimental data.
  4. Utilize advanced post-processing techniques to analyze simulation results, identifying key insights and communicating findings effectively to stakeholders.
  5. Stay current with industry trends and advancements in CFD technology, integrating new tools and methodologies into the engineering workflow.
  6. Perform advanced Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) modeling for quantitative risk analysis, including Fire and Explosion analysis, Gas Detectors allocation, Flame Detection Allocation, Exhaust and Vent dispersion, Smoke and Gas Dispersion, Flare Radiation Analysis, and Helideck Turbulence Analysis.
  7. Assist qualitative risk analysis (e.g., HAZOP, HAZID) and vulnerability analysis to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  8. Support Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA) to ensure compliance with safety standards.
  9. Mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team.
  10. Implement and maintain ABS Quality System requirements relative to responsibilities after undergoing ABS Quality System training.
  11. Draft technically accurate and timely reports, and responses to letters, faxes, and other forms of communication.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience:

  1. Master’s in chemical, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related field with a strong emphasis on fluid dynamics and experience on O&G projects.
  2. Experience in CFD analysis, with proficiency in industry-standard software such as FLACS, KFX, CFX, ANSYS Fluent, OpenFOAM, or COMSOL.
  3. Solid understanding of turbulence modeling, heat transfer, and multiphase flow dynamics.
  4. Experience in qualitative risk analysis (e.g., HAZOP, HAZID) and vulnerability analysis.
  5. Experience in Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA).
  6. Familiarity with Process Safety Management (PSM) principles.
  7. Knowledge of Brazilian regulations (e.g., Petrobras Safety Guidelines, ANP, NRs) is a plus.
  8. Professional or chartered engineering license.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities:

  1. The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems (i.e., the competence to demonstrate complex problem-solving skills).
  2. Good command of the English language with the ability to communicate orally and in writing.
  3. Expertise in computational fluid dynamics simulation and modeling techniques.
  4. Proficiency in software tools for mesh generation, simulation, and post-processing.
  5. Understanding of numerical methods and algorithms used in CFD.
  6. Critical thinking and problem-solving capacity.
  7. Ability to work effectively in a team and independently.
  8. Ability to handle fast-paced, high-demand environments with strong stress management skills.
  9. Ability to work well with others.
  10. Ability to obtain working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

It Would Be Nice If You Have:

  1. Experience in applying CFD to aerospace, automotive, or energy systems.
  2. Experience in scripting or programming languages (Python, MATLAB) to automate processes and enhance simulation capabilities.
  3. Familiarity with high-performance computing (HPC) environments and parallel processing techniques.
  4. Strong publication record in peer-reviewed journals or conference proceedings.

Reporting Relationships:

The incumbent reports to a senior level engineer or technical manager. This position does not have any direct reports.

description:

Job Description

Posted Friday, March 7, 2025 at 5:00 AM

Questrade Financial Group (QFG), through its companies - Questrade, Inc., Questrade Wealth Management Inc., Community Trust Company, ThinkInsure, Zolo, and Flexiti, provides securities and foreign currency investment, professionally managed investment portfolios, mortgages, insurance, real estate services, financial services and more. Questrade uses cutting-edge technologies to develop innovative products that give customers better, more affordable ways to take control of their money.

We are everything a traditional financial institution is not. At QFG, you will be constantly moving forward, bringing the future of fintech into existence. You will be a part of a collaborative team that cares deeply about our mission and each other. Your team members will help you conquer challenges, push boundaries and discover what you are truly capable of.

This is a place where you can explore, discover and learn with continuous growth. As a diverse and inclusive place to work, with a hybrid working environment you can unleash your creativity and curiosity with no limits. If you share the same sense of infinite possibility, come shape your future at QFG.

What’s in it for you as an employee of QFG?

  1. Health & wellbeing resources and programs
  2. Paid vacation, personal, and sick days for work-life balance
  3. Competitive compensation and benefits packages
  4. Work-life balance
  5. Career growth and development opportunities
  6. Opportunities to contribute to community causes
  7. Work with diverse team members in an inclusive and collaborative environment

We’re looking for our next Senior Cloud Data Platform Engineer. Could It Be You?

The Questrade Technology Group (QTG) is home to a unique environment, where our culture thrives and most importantly, we get stuff done! Questrade is continuing with its digital transformation initiative and our infrastructure footprint is growing beyond our data centres and into the Google Cloud Platform. We are currently working towards our exciting strategy that is driven by business value. Join us and help solve some complex challenges such as handling low latency and high traffic market data, event streams and messaging, in a hybrid cloud environment within an industry that has so much room for disruption.

The Cloud Data Platform Engineer will work with a primary focus on delivering Questrade’s Data Platform footprint, as an expansion of our cloud presence, enabling key initiatives such as our Digital Banking. This role will be working with several teams in the organization in a collaborative manner, helping deliver data related components that enable productivity across QTG by leveraging automation to deliver self-service components as much as possible. This key individual will be part of a team that drives the implementation of data components such as pipelines, applications, sanitation, supporting our data scientists and working with the rest of the product teams while collaborating with the architecture team, influencing the design and delivery of our data footprint and striving for greater functionality in our data systems.

Our Cloud Data Platform Engineer needs to be able to gather and understand engineering requirements, provide a solution, and work in the team to achieve high quality features. This Engineer will need a passion for complex problems, and enjoy the challenge of operating complex and mission critical systems under extreme loads. Do you think you are up to the challenge? Would you like to learn more and stretch your skills and career?

In this role, you will be a technical expert with significant scope and impact. You will work closely with a group of Software Engineers, Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Data Engineers to create the data infrastructure and pipelines necessary to drive Questrade’s initiatives. Successful candidates should come from a strong data engineering background. You need to have experience with structured and unstructured data, and being able to analyze/transform the data using various tools. You need to have experience in Cloud Services, Terraform and CI/CD Pipelines. Often, the pace of innovation and change implies a need to set up connections to new data sources, and our Data Platform Engineers get to participate in deep diving business use cases in order to provide automated solutions. Your analytical skills and knowledge of schema metadata will be essential.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  1. Create and maintain optimal data pipeline architecture.
  2. Design and create new features and automated solutions that meet functional / non-functional business requirements.
  3. Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements: automating manual processes, implementing data governance rules, re-designing infrastructure for greater scalability, etc.
  4. In-depth understanding of Data Protection and Network security rules set up on Cloud Infrastructure.
  5. Expand and increase data platform capabilities to resolve new data problems and challenges by identifying, sourcing, and integrating new features.
  6. Work with stakeholders to assist with data-related technical issues and support their data infrastructure needs.
  7. Peer review code and promote dev ops culture within the data teams.
  8. Have a good understanding of data platform best practices to achieve economies of scale, cost reduction and efficiencies.
  9. Monitor and anticipate trends in data engineering, and propose changes in alignment with organizational goals and needs.
  10. Explore AI integrations into Data Engineering Development Cycle.

So are YOU our next Senior Cloud Data Platform Engineer? You are if you…

  1. Minimum 3+ years of experience working in the data engineering field.
  2. Proficiency in SQL language.
  3. Strong knowledge of Python language.
  4. Experience with any of the popular Clouds (GCP, AWS, Azure).
  5. Experience with CI/CD pipeline tooling and development.
  6. Good knowledge in Message Broker systems (e.g., Kafka, PubSub).
  7. Experience with ML Model Training using Google Vertex AI.
  8. Good knowledge of popular data standards and formats (e.g, JSON, XML, Proto, Parquet, Avro, ORC, etc).
  9. Experience in building Terraform scripts will be preferred.
  10. Good Knowledge of Airflow Operators and Airflow DAG Configuration.
  11. Experience in the financial industry is an asset.
  12. Google GCP data platform (Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Composer, BigQuery, CloudSQL) knowledge and experience is an asset, or knowledge of the equivalent open source toolset behind those products.

Summary
Performs CT scans of designated anatomy using professional judgment while imaging with regard to technical quality according to physician specifications. Provides courteous and professional delivery of CT technical exams and procedures while adhering to radiation safety precautions. Supports patient questions and concerns regarding exam procedures and process, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality regarding PHI and HIPPA related information. On-call as required by the department. Works in a hospital facility that offers full hospital services. Provides direct patient care to high acuity patients encompassing emergency, inpatient and outpatient classes supporting up to and including trauma and ICU.
Job Duties

  • Performs all types of imaging procedures and operates all equipment safely and properly including scanners, injectors, and monitors.
  • Reviews all images of all exams, repeating images as necessary for best possible result.
  • Communicates with the patient by addressing the patient by name, introducing self to the patient, explaining the exam in lay terms and keeping the patient Informed of exam progress.
  • Prepares patient images to PACs for interpretation by a radiologist and administers contrast media per protocol.
  • Completes technical notes, verifies images, and sends exams to PACS promptly.
  • Notifies physician of any adverse reaction to contrast media or change in patient's condition.
  • Reviews patient chart/script prior to initiating exam to verify pertinent information.
  • Prepares patients for CT procedures by accurately assessing patient’s needs, medical history, and provides patient education.
  • Operates computed tomography scanner for data acquisition, reconstruction of images, documentation of images, and performs quality control measures for the purpose of ensuring optimal quality images.
  • Attends department meetings or other mandatory meetings with a positive attitude.
  • Practices accurate and timely completion of scheduled and unscheduled work to maximize productivity.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Technical School Diploma Graduate of accredited Radiography program or equivalent or
  • CNMT, RT(CT) Certified
  • Less than 1 year experience as a Radiologic Technologist
  • Ability to provide proper patient care essential to radiologic procedures.
  • Knowledge and skills to perform scans on patients of all ages, adapting to various protocols.
  • Proficient use of the advanced software for CT scanning and post procedure processing applications.
  • Strong aptitude for CT technology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, positive attitude, and upbeat demeanor.
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 30 Days
  • RT - Registered Technologist Radiology - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire or
  • CNMT - Certified Nuclear Med Tech NMTCB - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire
  • CT - Computed Tomography ARRT - State of Pennsylvania within 1 Year
Preferred Qualifications
  • Associate’s Degree Graduate of Health Science program
  • Knowledge and skills to perform venipuncture.
Physical Demands
Lift and carry 40-50 lbs. Examples: Push/pull patients on bed, stretcher (requires 29 lbs. push force), lateral transfers up to 50 lbs. of the patient's weight. Frequent to continuous standing/walking. Patient transporters can walk 8-10 miles per shift. *Patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

title: Data Engineer - FinTech, Brazil Application
description:
Data Engineer - FinTech, Brazil Application

Are you passionate about data? Does the prospect of dealing with massive volumes of data excite you? Do you want to build data engineering solutions that process billions of records a day in a scalable fashion using Amazon Web Services technologies? Do you want to create the next-generation tools for intuitive data access?
Amazon's Finance Technology team is seeking truly innovative Data Engineer to join the team that is shaping the future of the finance data platform. The team is committed to building big data platforms that support Amazon's rapidly growing and dynamic businesses, and use it to deliver the BI applications which will have an immediate influence on day-to-day decision making. Amazon has culture of data-driven decision-making, and demands data that is timely, accurate, and actionable. Our platform serves Amazon's finance, tax and accounting functions across the globe.
As a Data Engineer, you should be an expert with data warehousing technical components (e.g. Data Modeling, ETL and Reporting), infrastructure (e.g. hardware and software) and their integration. You should have deep understanding of the architecture for enterprise level data warehouse solutions using multiple platforms (RDBMS, Columnar, Cloud). You should be an expert in the design, creation, management, and business use of large datasets. You should have excellent business and communication skills to be able to work with business owners to develop and define key business questions, and to build data sets that answer those questions. The individual is expected to be able to build efficient, flexible, extensible, and scalable ETL and reporting solutions. You should be enthusiastic about learning new technologies and be able to implement solutions using them to provide new functionality to the users or to scale the existing platform. Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required as the person will work very closely with diverse teams. Having strong analytical skills is a plus. Above all, you should be passionate about working with huge data sets and someone who loves to bring datasets together to answer business questions and drive change.
Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, relishes working with large transactional volumes and big data, enjoys the challenge of highly complex business contexts (that are typically being defined in real-time), and, above all, is a passionate about data and analytics. In this role you will be part of a team of engineers to create world's largest financial data warehouses and BI tools for Amazon's expanding global footprint.
Responsibilities:
- Design, implement, and support a platform providing secured access to large datasets.
- Interface with tax, finance and accounting customers, gathering requirements and delivering complete BI solutions.
- Model data and metadata to support ad-hoc and pre-built reporting.
- Own the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, dashboards, etc. to drive key business decisions.
- Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, and documentation.
- Tune application and query performance using profiling tools and SQL.
- Analyze and solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context.
- Learn and understand a broad range of Amazon’s data resources and know when, how, and which to use and which not to use.
- Keep up to date with advances in big data technologies and run pilots to design the data architecture to scale with the increased data volume using AWS.
- Continually improve ongoing reporting and analysis processes, automating or simplifying self-service support for datasets.
- Triage many possible courses of action in a high-ambiguity environment, making use of both quantitative analysis and business judgment.

Key job responsibilities
A Data Engineer II is an autonomous contributor who uses a broad set of design approaches to pragmatically solve difficult problems delivering high quality, stable and performant code. They use their expertise in team’s infrastructure and data products like Synchro, Oracle EBS, FGBSBI to provide technical direction to tax users, works with Tax Tech to understand the business requirements, defines physical and logical data model, designs the solution and contributes great amount to the code base, and guides other engineers on the same team as well as from other teams. They review their design with senior engineers to ensure data engineering best practices are followed. They insist on high standards and set an example with his code, design and implementation decisions. They lead the way in adopting native AWS technologies and implementing new trends in data engineering space. They continuously focus on operational excellence, constructively identify problems and propose solutions to fix them for good.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of data engineering experience
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)
